source_policy: one shared runtime with explicit compatibility profiles; scientific configurations and historical audit assertions preserved

verification.scope: bounded CPU and source compatibility only; not full-data GPU, real-image FID or paper reproduction

release_blockers: No public repository or permanent release identifier has been assigned.
Rights and upstream license notices require review; no project-wide license has been invented.
Required external paths and removed URLs remain placeholders by user request.
Datasets, model weights, training outputs and matched-run reference logs are not included.
Historical Krum/Soft audits require original matched artifacts and exact-source conditions; current-source startup/numerical tests do not substitute historical identity.
Full-data GPU/FID and exhaustive resume/protocol scenarios remain unvalidated; bounded synthetic CPU execution is not paper reproduction.
